quarterly_data.signal: Consolidated revenue reached $109.9 billion, up 22% year-over-year

Google operating income tripled year-over-year to $6.6 billion; operating margin increased from 17.8% to 32.9%
CapEx was $35.7 billion in Q1, overwhelming majority in technical infrastructure; approximately 60% in servers and 40% in data centers and networking
Full year 2026 CapEx guidance updated to $180 billion to $190 billion, up from $175 billion to $185 billion; 2027 CapEx expected to significantly increase compared to 2026
Google Search & Other revenues grew 19% to $60.4 billion
Google Services operating income increased 24% to $40.6 billion; operating margin was 45.3%
Net income increased 81% to $62.6 billion; EPS increased 82% to $5.11

Revenue from products built on GenAI models grew nearly 800% year-over-year in Q1; new customer acquisition doubled year-on-year
First-party models now process more than 16 billion tokens per minute via direct API, up from 10 billion last quarter
Gemini Enterprise paid monthly active users grew 40% quarter-over-quarter
Total paid subscriptions reached 350 million
Google will begin delivering TPUs to a select group of customers in their own data centers; small percent of revenues expected later in 2026 with vast majority in 2027
Sundar Pichai stated cloud revenue would have been higher if Google were able to meet compute demand, indicating supply constraints as a growth gating factor
Doubled number of $100 million to $1 billion deals year-on-year and signed multiple billion dollar plus deals in cloud
330 Google customers each processed over 1 trillion tokens over the past 12 months; 35 reached the 10 trillion token milestone
